title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
summary: A GitHub project (Strata) claims to run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, a 125B parameter model, on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100 tokens per second. The Hacker News discussion with 871 points and 390 comments likely debates the feasibility, techniques (quantization, offloading, MoE), and practical implications of running large models on single-GPU setups.
